screenshots.caption: Enter your own credentials and select Access Systems.
Select the organization that owns the records you will enter.
Create the company, then grant access before staff enter records.
Each company's Finance approval authority must be configured explicitly.
Access & Governance lists registered accounts.
Assign module access and company permissions.
Choose ERP responsibilities and company approval limits.
Initialize and review the standard chart of accounts.
Add a custom account with the correct account type.
Show archived accounts to review retained accounts; only the global Super Admin can select Restore.
Use the company workspace, side navigation and search to reach each connected module.
Search the directory before registering a new customer.
Complete the customer identity and category fields.
Catalog search, category filters, tier prices and stock.
Product identity, manual costs and category-price overrides.
Supplier directory, terms and assigned products.
Register the vendor's legal and contact details.
Maintain warehouse facilities in Master Inventory.
Create a bin using the six physical location levels.
Search products, generate missing QR records and print the required label.
Separate entry example: ten Sterile Syringe 5 mL units. The main fulfillment example uses one monitor on OS-1001.
Separate generated example OS-1002 for ten syringes (PHP 257.60). The same approval and document controls apply to the main OS-1001 example.
Select the supplier and source OS, then review the incrementing PO number.
The ledger identifies which receiving route applies.
Select requests and compare recorded supplier quotations.
Enter purpose, needed-by date, products and requested quantities.
Create import files, plan shipment quantities and maintain tracking.
Save cumulative clearance quantities and itemized import charges.
The receipt ledger separates accepted, rejected and held quantities.
Receive quantities and capture batch, expiry and inspection evidence.
The document workspace offers folders, Upload, local filtering and AI document search.
Review the expiry reminder list and source-document actions.
Link company-owned supporting documents to operational records.
Review stock conditions and the resulting bin/batch quantities.
Unsaved placement example: choose an accepted GRN item, destination warehouse/bin and physical quantity. Confirm only after checking the goods.
Enter invoice currency, FX, allocation basis and shipment charges.
Review saved landed-cost records and their current Finance approval status.
Create a draft supplier bill, review its source lines and approve posting.
Track reserved, incoming, delivered and remaining quantities in the unified P.O. workspace.
The document ledger retains quotations, order slips, FOs and packing lists.
Select a delivery, inspect source documents and follow the FEFO picking / POD workflow.
Choose the source, memo kind, amount and reason; retry unchanged content in the same open form after an uncertain response.
Choose the party and allocate the confirmed payment to outstanding documents.
Check the balance remaining after allocation.
Inspect a lot before transferring it or changing its condition.
Record counts and use approval or recount controls for differences.
The Historical Ledger records operational stock changes.
Choose accounts and keep total debits equal to total credits.
Account mappings separates automatic posting roles from item, party and account references.
Select POSTING_ROLE, its ERP role and a compatible active ledger account before saving.
Apply the Manila reporting period and review the posted-ledger financial cards and trend.
Profit & Loss includes posted revenue and expense accounts for the selected period.
Review assets, liabilities, recorded equity, unclosed earnings and the accounting-equation difference.
Trial Balance separates opening balances, period movements and closing debit/credit balances.
Choose a ledger account, follow its running balance and export the complete filtered result.
Choose the approved asset account and save whether it belongs in cash/bank reporting.
Classify a posted signed cash entry, explain the reason and save a new audited version.
Review cash-flow totals, completeness and unmatched-transfer details before exporting the complete report.
Compare separate office/warehouse reference values with posted Inventory and investigate exception rows.
Preview statement transactions, match posted bank entries and reconcile the closing balance.
Audit events preserve the actor, action and record context.
Register verified delivered serials and review warranty/maintenance dates.
Schedule a visit and record its technician, notes, status and costs.
Review the permitted financial overview, then continue down to operational alerts and forecasts.
Select a management report and export CSV or Excel.
Ask a specific company question and review the sources before acting.
The payroll dashboard starts a separate personnel-to-payroll workflow.
Enter personnel, salary, loan and statutory details.
Locate the employee and maintain their saved record.
Confirm pay basis, fixed divisor or weekdays, and overtime method before saving the profile.
Select the cutoff, enter minute-level times and confirm Save Attendance.
Review the server-confirmed calculation, deductions and final net pay before saving.
Review the saved employee payslip, then select Print Slip.
Select the intended date basis, date range and employee before applying filters.
Set the reporting range and employee, then review and print the summary.
